history.summary: A 710 sqft freehold 2BR at The Lilium (2022) in D19 Bartley at $1.528M ($2,152 PSF), 670m from Bartley CC12 MRT. Freehold, new-ish, MRT-walkable and the widest 2BR tenant pool — but $2,152 PSF is full freehold-launch pricing with new-launch bias flagged.
history.rating_rationale: Solid fundamentals: freehold tenure, 2022 build, 670m to Bartley MRT (CC line), efficient 2BR with deep rental demand, and a healthy 72-txn base. The catch is price — $2,152 PSF reflects new-launch pricing (bias flagged), so the buyer enters near peak with limited near-term upside. $1.528M is in the liquid band. A fair, defensible Neutral: good asset, fully-priced entry.
red_flags: $2,152 PSF is full freehold new-launch pricing; bias flagged
Bought near launch peak — limited near-term capital headroom
Bartley is a quieter D19 pocket vs prime catalysts
catalysts: Efficient 2BR — widest tenant pool and resale buyer base
